title: Jellyfin
intro: Let your agents search your Jellyfin library and see what is playing. If you allow it, they can also remote control players, mark things watched, set favourites and add to playlists.
limits: This connection does not answer messages. An agent uses Jellyfin only when you ask it in a chat. It cannot delete, scan or edit the library, and it cannot manage users.
name: Name
tokenHelp: Made in the Jellyfin dashboard. It is kept sealed and never shown again.
tokenSaved: Saved. Type a key to replace it.
tokenSpace: The key has no spaces or quotes. Copy it again without the characters around it.
serverHelp: The address you open Jellyfin with, for example http://192.168.1.10:8096. One connection holds one server; add another connection for a second server. The agent reaches this address and no other.
serverShape: This is not a web address. Write it like http://192.168.1.10:8096 or https://media.example.
serverScheme: The address starts with http:// or https://.
serverUser: Leave the user name and password out of the address.
serverQuery: Leave out everything after ? and #. Use the box below for a certificate fingerprint.
httpNote: This address is not encrypted: the API key travels in plain text. Use it only on a network you trust.
pin: Certificate fingerprint (only for a self-signed certificate)
pinHelp: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server certificate, from your browser's certificate view. With it, LocalAI accepts that one certificate and no other. Leave it empty when the certificate comes from a public authority.
pinShape: A SHA-256 fingerprint is 64 hexadecimal digits. Colons and spaces are fine.
pinHttp: A fingerprint goes with an https:// address.
checkSeveral: The server check runs when you have one Jellyfin connection, because a check from this page cannot tell which one you mean. In a chat, enable the connections in the Tools menu.

check.title: Check of {{name}}
check.ok: {{name}} {{version}} answers, and the key is accepted.
check.keyRefused: {{name}} {{version}} answers, but it refused the key. Check that the key was not deleted in the dashboard.
check.refused: The server refused the key. Check that it was not deleted in the dashboard.
check.certificate: The certificate is not trusted. For a self-signed certificate, add its SHA-256 fingerprint; if you did, the server shows another certificate now.
check.failed: The server did not answer. Check the address and that the server is on.

noServer: No server listed: the agent can reach none.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.message: The agent can no longer reach this server, and the key saved with it is deleted. To set it up again you must enter the key again.

setup.title: How to make the key
setup.step1: Open the Jellyfin dashboard as an administrator and go to Advanced, then API Keys.
setup.step2: Choose the plus button, name the key, for example LocalAI, and confirm.
setup.step3: Copy the key that appears in the list and paste it in the key field here.
setup.step4: Enter the address of the server as you open it in a browser, with the port.
setup.admin: A Jellyfin API key works for the whole server, not for one user. The write mode below is what limits the agent. If you delete the key in the dashboard, this connection stops working at once.

writeMode.label: What the agent may change on Jellyfin
writeMode.hint: Remote control of players, watched marks, favourites and adding to playlists. It never deletes, scans or edits the library.

line.propose: Each change waits for your OK.

note.off: Write access is off: this connection only reads.
note.propose: Each change waits in your approvals until you confirm it. The card names the player and the user it affects.
note.auto: A chat of yours acts at once, without asking: it can pause or stop what other people are watching. Runs without you present still wait for your confirmation.

command.play: Play an item on a player
command.set-volume: Set the volume of a player

approval.others: Other people may be watching this player. This interrupts them.
approval.names: Names are read from your Jellyfin server.
